title: AI services firm for Main Street “boring” businesses
one_liner: Productized AI agency: one high-ticket local niche, one painful problem, local Meta ads, case studies, then rinse/repeat.
why_agent_runnable: Research, asset-pack drafting, lead scoring, SOP capture, and reporting are agent-native. Brandon only steers niche pick and approves money/hire/pay/publish/send.

ops_steps.title: Score niches + geos
ops_steps.detail: Apply @boringmarketer 100-pt opportunity score across 30 high-ticket local niches × candidate geos. Output ranked shortlist with Maps/SEO evidence.

ops_steps.title: Brandon picks niche/geo
ops_steps.detail: Choose one niche + one geo from shortlist.

ops_steps.title: One-problem asset pack
ops_steps.detail: Draft offer, math/receipts one-pager, landing copy, application form, creative briefs. Stay in draft until publish gate.

ops_steps.title: Publish + ads approval
ops_steps.detail: Approve domain, public copy, Meta ads budget, and outbound identity.

ops_steps.title: Hyper-local Meta campaign
ops_steps.detail: Launch application-flow ads; log leads; draft replies — no send without Brandon.

ops_steps.title: Design-partner delivery
ops_steps.detail: Delivery checklists, CRM notes, weekly ROI attribution. Contractor hire/pay requires Brandon gate.

ops_steps.title: Case study + productize
ops_steps.detail: Film/write case study (publish gate), lock SOPs, propose next geo.

human_only_checkpoints: Any ad spend or tool paid upgrade
Publishing site, ads, case studies, social

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs job posts, contractor shortlists, and payment memos in /plans drafts.

unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: High software margin after SOPs; fulfillment time is the constraint. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1-2: score 30 niches × 5 geos; deliver shortlist
Day 7: ads live + lead CRM skeleton (no outbound send)
kill_criteria: Cannot find geo with weak Maps competition AND $1k+ tickets after 2 scoring passes
Zero qualified applications after 14 days at agreed ad budget
Cannot attribute a measurable call/revenue outcome for first 2 design partners
Brandon declines further spend at any money gate
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
